about: A Viking hall with a shingled roof: a tall gabled hall (dragon-head carvings on both gable peaks) with its carved double door at the front (-Y), and a lower hip-roofed wing on its right (+X); plank walls hung with round shields on a dry-stone base. Sized by the door: 0.155 model units tall for a 2 m door, so a unit is 12.9 m and its 0.793 units front to back are 10 m (the shields come out 0.9 m across, as Viking shields are). 12.4 m wide, 10 m tall to the carving's top.
